messages.author: afc064a3b499df5c
messages.subject: Cannot Access DataSource using RODBC
parts:
I have perfectly deployed my application.
I am on my company's network. They probably use proxies. My application uses the RODBC connection to run various queries & generate graphs. 

It works perfectly on local. 

However, whenever I run it using the URL, I get the following error in the JavaScript console on Google Chrome.

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:45422 Loading required package: ggplot2 Warning in odbcDriverConnect("DSN=DatabaseName") : [RODBC] ERROR: state IM002, code 0, message [unixODBC][Driver Manager]Data source name not found, and no default driver specified Warning in odbcDriverConnect("DSN=DatabaseName") : ODBC connection failed Error in sqlQuery(c, "select datepart(ww,ActivityDate) as 'WeekNum', count(distinct personid) as 'No_of_Users'\nfrom DatabaseName.dbo.PersonActivity\ngroup by datepart(ww,ActivityDate)\norder by 1\n ") : first argument is not an open RODBC channel


Does anyone have any suggestions on how to fix this?

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Cannot Access DataSource using RODBC
parts:
Sagnik,

Can you explain how you are running/accessing your application in local mode (when it works fine)? The URL you mentioned (http://127.0.0.1:45422) is also running locally. I am trying to understand the difference between the 2 scenarios.

When you deployed you application to shinyapps.io, what was the URL you got for the app?
Is your application trying to connect to a database within your network? If so, your database has to be accessible from outside your environment. Do you know if that is the case?


Best,
Fereshteh
